title: The Shepherdess (The Escape to the Stars)

full_text:
Upon the polished parlor table, the porcelain shepherdess and the little chimney sweep pledged their gentle hearts to one another. When the grandfatherly Chinese mandarin attempted to force her marriage to the grinning mahogany satyr, the lovers fled up through the dark, soot-filled chimney to the starlit roof.

Beholding the infinite, terrifying expanse of the sleeping city, the delicate maiden wept with fear. The faithful chimney sweep, valuing her peace above all else, guided her tenderly back to the fireside table, where their love endured unshaken by the threats of the world.
moral: Love dares to venture into the vast unknown, yet finds sacred peace in the shelter of home.
